name: MGB OIL P
description: Main gearbox oil pressure is below minimum (transmission oil pressure indication 1 bar or less, SYS 1 and 2). Warning Unit shows MGB OIL P and audio tone, Master List shows MGB LOW PRESS, voice message "MAIN GEARBOX, LOW PRESSURE".

procedure.heading: In flight:
procedure.text:
1. Power — Reduce
2. Airspeed — Set to VY
3. LAND IMMEDIATELY (maximum 15 min)
Descend with minimum power. MGB loss-of-oil capability has been demonstrated on a bench test (at VY power setting) for 30 minutes.
